name: Before Eating
arabic: (بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، وَلَاَ حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ).

transliterations.latin: Bismil-lahi, tevekkeltu ala All-llahi, ve la havle ve la kuvvete il-la bil-lah

translations.albanian: Me emrin e Allahut, në Allahun u mbështeta, nuk ka ndryshim e as forcë pa ndihmën e Allahut.
translations.english: (In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.)
translations.indonesian: Ya Allah, sesungguhnya aku berlindung kepadaMu, jangan sampai aku sesat atau disesatkan (setan atau orang yang berwatak
